plan: Compute a single Fraction scale ratio target_yield/recipe_yield and apply it to every ingredient quantity (main and components) up front.

Resolve exclusions with a recursive resolver: each excluded ingredient looks up catalog choices filtered by `for`, sorted by (priority, catalog index) for deterministic selection; the winning choice's result rewrites name/quantity/unit/preparation.

Carry a chain frozenset of names through the recursion to detect substitution cycles; re-run the resolver on replacements and on result-supplied additional ingredients so chained substitutions and reintroduced exclusions (with warnings) are handled uniformly.

Accumulate side effects in dedicated collectors: wording-change pairs (applied to all instruction strings in a final pass), an equipment set mutated by additions/removals then validated against available_equipment and emitted sorted, and a cumulative yield factor compensated by a final quantity rescale so the recipe stays at target yield.

Collect all impossibility reasons into a set across every ingredient and every equipment item (never short-circuiting), returning them sorted with recipe=null; otherwise return the fully rebuilt adapted recipe with sorted warnings and ordered choice IDs.
Guarantee non-mutation by constructing all output dicts fresh (deepcopy for opaque component fields) and have print_original return authored_text verbatim.
mechanisms: Fraction scale ratio for yield adaptation
(priority, catalog-index) sort key for deterministic catalog choice
recursive exclusion resolver with chain-set cycle detection
uniform re-resolution of replacements and additional ingredients for chained substitution and reintroduction warnings
side-effect accumulators: wording-change list, equipment set, cumulative yield factor with compensating rescale
authored_text pass-through for byte-exact original printing
